init_SawyerButtonPressWallEnvV2: create a SawyerButtonPressWallEnvV2 instance with hand and object initialization bounds for the button press wall task
evaluate_state: evaluate the robot state and compute reward with success info given observations and actions
compute_reward: compute the button press reward using tcp distance and button proximity tolerance functions
reset_model: reset the Sawyer robot model to initial hand and button positions with optional random initialization
set_obj_xyz: set the button object XYZ position by updating joint position and velocity state
